latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of sop-generator: transform recordings, transcripts, notes, or brain dumps into clear, actionable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
- Includes guidance for extracting and structuring SOPs from Loom videos, voice memos, meeting transcripts, and messy written notes.
- Provides a repeatable SOP template with sections for purpose, tools, steps, edge cases, metrics, maintenance, and related processes.
- Features a quality checklist to ensure SOPs are actionable, complete, and easy to follow.
- Offers best practices for organizing and maintaining an SOP library over time.
